svg.title: Proposition 2.5 factor of two
svg.desc: Two Gaussian densities around a quadratic minimum: the exact minimiser of the Information Lagrangian, which is also the Gibbs distribution, and the covariance stated in Proposition 2.5, which is about half as wide. Right: the Lagrangian as a function of the variance, with the correct second-order term and with the paper's, which drops the one-half and so moves the minimum to half the variance.
svg.text: Proposition 2.5: the optimal perturbation is twice as wide as stated
Quadratic loss (h = 4), prior N(0, 1), β = 0.05. Left: densities. Right: the Lagrangian in σ².
½ tr(HΣ) + β KL (correct Taylor term)
